name: Venia
source:
The prime minister of the fairy world who supports the fairy queen Titania.
She has an androgynous look that touches both male and female.
Her tone is superficially polite but when she opens her mouth sooner or later you will be bombarded with sarcastic and disagreeable remarks that dig into your heart.
